builders.name: Swyx
builders.summary_en: Confident predictions that a team cannot reach state of the art can attract attention even when they are quickly disproved. Social media rewards both the original claim and the later apology.
builders.summary_zh: 断言某团队不可能达到最先进水平，即使很快被事实推翻，也可能获得大量关注。社交媒体甚至会同时奖励错误预测和事后的道歉。

keywords.example_zh: 有人断言某团队达到 SOTA 的概率已降为零，三个月后却被成果打脸；作者借此讽刺社交媒体的流量机制。

keywords.definition_zh: 指在思考或判断时始终记住某个因素。
keywords.example_zh: 作者提醒读者，刷社交媒体时要记住：武断预测和事后道歉都可能获得大量点赞。

tweets.text: you cant be serious https://t.co/pll3CcsPFp

when scrolling social media i think it is worth bearing in mind that you can say “odds of reaching SOTA have dropped to zero” and get alot of likes and then 3 months later when they have reached SOTA you post apology form and get even more likes and the subject of your writing prints it out and thanks you for motivation

theres no consequences at all for inaccuracy and every incentive for hyperbole and the x algorithm is tuned for this
tweets.summary_en: Social media rewards confident hyperbole even when it proves wrong: both inaccurate predictions and subsequent apologies can attract engagement. X’s incentives favor attention over accountability.

tweets.text:
Same same, but now it’s PR-maxxing 🤦‍♂️

Focus on the what, who and why, and not on the how!! https://t.co/O3cjhVuuP1

As these network attacks and impersonation attempts happen, who's securing the elderly? 

Especially thinking about my parents and grandparents.

There are four layers I can think through where this could work.

One is at the browser level, where somebody builds a secure browser that ensures that whatever websites they're going to are secured. Texts typically lead to a link, even for payments. This is why browser is key.

Two could be at the network layer, where there is a physical device, similar to Pi-hole, or an Onavo-like VPN on your phone, that blocks websites that could be deemed unsafe.

Three could be at the payments layer, where transactions that look like scams get flagged before the money leaves.

And fourth and most crazy could be at the phone level, where everything is monitored, and you're only getting calls from your loved ones. Cloned voices would work with a provider like Reality Defender. 

There are individual solutions for this today but none neatly packaged. 

This could all be packaged with insurance that covers any activities on the OS or phone. In that way, incentives are aligned to keep this on the edge.

The buyer would be the kids, someone like me, who get alerted when something looks off.
tweets.summary_en: Protecting older adults from scams could combine browser and network safeguards, payment screening, and phone-level impersonation detection into one service. Adult children could buy it for their parents, receive alerts, and get insurance coverage that aligns the provider’s incentives with preventing fraud.

I am just immensely proud of our industry today.

slang_glossary.definition_zh: 「道歉表」梗：当某人或某事表现超出预期时，用来戏谑地收回先前批评的模板。

slang_glossary.definition_en: An elongated spelling of a profanity, used to express intense frustration or disbelief.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 英语粗口 fuck 的拉长写法，用来表达强烈的烦躁、震惊或难以置信。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Develops over time and produces an eventual result.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 逐步展开；发展并最终产生结果。

slang_glossary.definition_en: To introduce a product or feature to users, often gradually.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 推出或逐步向用户开放产品、功能。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Experiments that compare two versions using separate groups to measure their effects.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: A/B 测试：让不同组分别使用两个版本，以比较其效果的实验。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Informal shorthand for statistically significant: meeting a specified statistical threshold under a test's assumptions, without necessarily implying practical importance.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 「具有统计显著性」的简称：在检验假设下达到指定统计阈值，但不一定意味着实际影响很大。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Describing a direct comparison or competition between two alternatives.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 直接对比的；正面对决的。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Reviews that express strong enthusiasm and praise.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 热烈好评；高度赞扬的评价。

slang_glossary.definition_en: In interface design, to keep an item fixed in an easily accessible location.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 在界面中将项目固定在便于访问的位置。

slang_glossary.definition_en: An interface element containing tabs for switching between sections or features.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 标签栏：包含多个标签、用于切换页面区域或功能的界面组件。
